critique: The render now strongly matches the preset’s intended graphic language: a pure black field, crisp flat triangle sprites, and a convincing mint-at-birth to neon-green-later color shift. Motion between t1 and t4 is clearly outward and energetic, with particles reaching a substantially wider area than before. It is still not quite as airy and deliberately composed as the thumbnail-style 2D triangle field: several oversized triangles overlap through the central area, while a few isolated large shapes dominate the distribution. A slightly faster, smaller particle field would preserve the expansion while making more individual triangles readable across the composition.

suggestions.why: Increase outward travel so the t4 arrangement disperses more broadly from the center and reads as a full-frame graphic field.
Reduce the largest triangle size to limit central overlaps and keep individual triangle silhouettes legible during expansion.
